LanguageData.MST.maxDensityComment: The density grid stores absolute density; this is only the 'full' reference. Changing it does not move existing gas, but does change render saturation and the extinction threshold.
LanguageData.MST.harmfulDensityComment: Gas above this density harms pawns. Raising it from 0 clears AO's static cache here, otherwise newly harmful gas needs a game restart.
LanguageData.MST.exposureStatComment: A resistance switch, not a multiplier: damage happens only when this stat is above 0 (or unset).
LanguageData.MST.diffusionIterationsComment: Diffusion iterations per tick. Performance sensitive.
LanguageData.MST.extinctionDensityFractionComment: Cells below (fraction x max density) are zeroed.
